title: R.I.P.: Better Models by Survival of the Fittest Prompts
authors_zh: Ping Yu、Weizhe Yuan、Olga Golovneva 等（Meta、纽约大学、加州大学伯克利分校）
paper_type_zh: 提示完整性筛选与合成偏好数据构造研究
best_for_zh: 适合希望在偏好优化前筛除含糊或低价值提示的读者。
one_line: RIP selects instruction prompts by rejected-answer quality and preference reward gap before DPO training.
RIP 通过拒选回答质量和偏好奖励间隔筛选提示，再构造用于 DPO 的记录。
why: It makes prompt integrity a measurable gate for preference-data construction and consumption.
inclusion_reason: Filters and generates training prompts using properties of the preference pairs that DPO will consume.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference optimization often scores responses while assuming that every input prompt is worth learning from. Real prompt pools include vague, malformed, overly open-ended, or otherwise low-integrity instructions that can produce unstable preference pairs.

RIP asks how to judge prompt usefulness from the responses it induces. It uses the quality of the rejected answer and the reward gap within a pair to decide whether the prompt should remain in a training or synthetic-data seed pool.

偏好优化常为回答打分，却假定每个输入提示都值得学习。真实提示池包含模糊、格式错误、过度开放或其他完整性较低的指令，它们会产生不稳定的偏好对。

RIP 追问如何从提示引出的回答判断提示是否有用。它使用拒选回答的质量和样本对内的奖励间隔，决定该提示是否应保留在训练或合成数据种子池中。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
RIP treats a weak rejected answer as information about the input, not only about the answer. If a model can produce particularly poor or highly variable responses for a prompt, that prompt may be unclear or unsuitable for reliable preference learning.

The method combines this rejected-response signal with the reward gap between chosen and rejected answers. The resulting prompt score selects existing prompts and can also seed Self-RIP, where high-integrity prompts guide later synthetic prompt generation.

RIP 将较差的拒选回答视为关于输入的信息，而不只是关于回答的信息。如果模型面对某个提示能产生特别差或高度变化的回答，该提示可能不清晰，或不适合可靠的偏好学习。

该方法将拒选回答信号与优选和拒选回答之间的奖励间隔结合。所得提示分数选择已有提示，也可作为 Self-RIP 的种子，其中完整性较高的提示引导后续合成提示生成。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a preference pair, RIP scores the rejected response and the chosen-versus-rejected reward gap. Prompts whose response behavior indicates weak integrity are filtered before DPO, while retained prompts can be paired with model-generated responses and reward-model annotations.

Self-RIP first uses RIP-curated prompts as few-shot examples to generate new instructions, then applies RIP again to the generated prompts. The paper reports DPO experiments on WildChat and HelpSteer2 as well as synthetic instruction data.

对于一个偏好对，RIP 为拒选回答以及优选和拒选回答之间的奖励间隔打分。其回答行为显示完整性较弱的提示在 DPO 前被过滤，而保留提示可与模型生成回答和奖励模型标注配对。

Self-RIP 先使用 RIP 整理的提示作为少样本示例来生成新指令，再对生成提示应用 RIP。论文报告了 WildChat、HelpSteer2 和合成指令数据上的 DPO 实验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The ICML paper reports that RIP filters 77% of training examples in its highlighted setting while improving Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on AlpacaEval 2 length-controlled win rate by 9.4%, Arena-Hard by 8.7%, and WildBench by 9.9%.

It also reports an Arena-Hard increase from 67.5 to 82.9 for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, and releases a filtered WildChat dataset. These results substantiate the proposed filtering in the studied settings, but depend on reward-model scores and benchmark-specific prompt distributions.

ICML 论文报告，在突出设置中 RIP 过滤了 77% 的训练样本，同时使 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 AlpacaEval 2 长度控制胜率提高 9.4%，Arena-Hard 提高 8.7%，WildBench 提高 9.9%。

它还报告 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 的 Arena-Hard 从 67.5 提高到 82.9，并发布了过滤后的 WildChat 数据集。这些结果证实了所研究设置中的过滤效果，但依赖奖励模型分数和特定基准的提示分布。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Most preference-data curation ranks the preferred answer or the pair as a whole. RIP foregrounds the rejected answer: what the model can do badly is used as a diagnostic for whether the prompt itself is a sound training input.

The same rule is applied twice in Self-RIP, connecting prompt selection to synthetic prompt construction. This is a data-construction contribution, not a new DPO loss, and its released filtered dataset makes the selection result inspectable.

大多数偏好数据整理对优选回答或整个样本对排序。RIP 突出拒选回答：模型能够做得多差被用作诊断提示本身是否是可靠训练输入的信号。

同一规则在 Self-RIP 中被应用两次，将提示选择连接到合成提示构造。这是一项数据构造贡献，而不是新的 DPO 损失；其发布的过滤数据集使选择结果可被检查。

title: Limitations
局限
html: RIP assumes reward scores and rejected-answer behavior identify prompt integrity, but both can reflect reward-model bias, model weakness, or a distribution where unusual prompts are valuable. Its threshold discards a large fraction of data and can remove rare but useful capabilities. Reuse must audit prompt provenance, response-generation settings, reward model, and the filtered dataset license.
RIP 假定奖励分数和拒选回答行为能识别提示完整性，但两者也可能反映奖励模型偏见、模型弱点，或罕见提示很有价值的分布。其阈值会丢弃大量数据，也可能删除稀有但有用的能力。复用时必须审计提示来源、回答生成设置、奖励模型和过滤数据集许可证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use RIP when prompt quality, not only answer ranking, is suspected to limit a preference-training corpus. It provides an operational filter and a released example dataset, and it is especially useful before investing in response generation or expensive preference annotation for a broad prompt pool.
当怀疑限制偏好训练语料的是提示质量而不只是回答排序时，应使用 RIP。它提供可操作的过滤器和发布的示例数据集，尤其适合在为宽泛提示池投入回答生成或昂贵偏好标注之前使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the two score definitions together and inspect the ablation that separates rejected-response quality from reward gap. For reproduction, freeze the prompt pool, response sampling, reward model, cutoff percentile, and validation set before training; otherwise a prompt filter can silently become an evaluation-tuned data recipe.
应将两个分数定义一起阅读，并检查把拒选回答质量与奖励间隔分开的消融实验。复现时应在训练前固定提示池、回答采样、奖励模型、截断百分位和验证集；否则提示过滤器会悄然变成针对评估调优的数据方案。
